title: Following a reaction by TLC
caption: Spotting the reaction mixture on TLC plates over time shows the starting material (Rf 0.55) fading as the product (Rf 0.30) grows. When the starting-material spot has gone, the reaction is complete.
alt: Three TLC plates at 0, 30 and 60 minutes; the high spot fades and the low spot appears.
description: 0 min: only the starting material spot.
60 min: only the product spot: complete.
